name: Kimiyoshi Natsumi
source:
A girl related to the Kimiyoshi family, one of the famous Hinamizawa families. She used to live in Okinomiya, but moved to the city for her father's sake. She lives with her grandma and her parents, and is a very cheerful girl.

[From 07th Expansion Wikia]
